topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Rain's been pouring down since early, blurring the lines of this city. Got a call just this afternoon, a lady's voice on the line, soft and uncertain. Figured her neighbor, a run-of-the-mill guy, turned out to be swimming in cash. Secrets are like rain, they seep through the cracks, never stay hidden for long. Listened to her, could hear the wheels turning, wondering how it all fit together. Told her I'd look into it, see what I could dig up. Promised to handle it with care, not just for her sake, but for the truth of it. People get skittish when the cards are laid out, but every story deserves its ending.
